name: ShugoArts
about_text: ShugoArts is a contemporary art gallery in Tokyo's Roppongi district, founded in 2000 by Shugo Satani, who drew on experience gained at his father Kazuhiko's Satani Gallery. Working with a deliberately small roster, the gallery builds long-term relationships with each artist, staging exhibitions that let their practices develop over time. Its program spans generations, from painters and sculptors who rose to prominence in the 1980s to photographers and artists who emerged from the 2000s onward, encompassing painting, sculpture, photography and glass work. In recent years ShugoArts has also dealt in secondary-market twentieth-century masterpieces, contributing to museum and private collection-building in Japan and abroad.

The crawled inventory sample consists almost entirely of individual exhibition detail pages (e00xxx/e01xxx IDs) with no visible archive list, roster index, about, or contact pages; these top-level pages likely exist in the site nav but are missing from this batch of the inventory. The inventory sample consists almost entirely of individual exhibition pages under /exhibitions/e#####, each with a unique catalogue number but no visible date metadata, suggesting these are archive entries; no roster, about, or contact pages appear in this batch though the site clearly has such sections given its long-running gallery program.
